title: Women Empowerment
text: With Flamenco being such a significant part of Andalusia as well as an empowering activity for a group of women, I searched for the best class option. This experience far exceeded our expectations. Eva is so gifted with teaching. Not only did she make the class fun for all, but she taught us the history. It was fascinating to see all of the cultural influences of the dance. We left dancing through the streets of Seville, and understanding the powerful energy behind it. I’ll definitely bring another group back next year. Thank you!
author: amberbV5391VC

title: Flamenco adventure
text: This was a great introduction to Flamenco and the art of the dance. The instructor was very passionate about teaching and incorporating some history and facts about the dance. She paced the class well and provided modified steps so all levels would be capable of participating.  At the end we were able to dance as a group and record it. The studio was bright and easy to locate.

title: Flamenco flop
text: We went into this experience knowing we could not dance, but we still had a great time. Our instructor was very patient with us.  The best part was we could better understand some of the dance steps we saw when we went to see a show that night.  If you don't take yourself to seriously, you can have fun with this experience.
author: Glenn_B

title: Rugby Girls do Flamenco Ole!!
text:
We visited  for a traditional Flamenco dance class. We are a Team of women rugby players from the U.K. we are all of different shapes and sizes and although excited about our lesson some were nervous and apprehensive.... 
Eva quickly made us feel at ease and we all had fun choosing our traditional Flamenco skirts shawls and fabulous shoes. There was a large selection of styles and sizes to suit everyone. 
Our lesson started with  warm up and intro to new people from other groups present for lesson.
